mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, username, display_name, password_hash, status, created_at, updated_at FROM app_users WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND username = #{username} AND status = 'active'
SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, username, display_name, password_hash, status, created_at, updated_at FROM app_users WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active'

SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.tenant_id, u.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.password_hash, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM app_users u INNER JOIN app_user_roles ur ON ur.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND ur.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.status = 'active' AND ur.role_code IN ('agent', 'supervisor', 'admin') ORDER BY u.user_id ASC
